description.en: A monthly internet bundle: 10 GB of data valid for 30 days for 10,000 IQD.
description.ar: باقة انترنت شهرية: 10 جيجابايت صالحة لمدة 30 يوم مقابل 10,000 دينار عراقي.
description.ckb: پاکێجی ئینتەرنێتی مانگانە: 10 گێگابایت بۆ ماوەی 30 ڕۆژ بە 10,000 دیناری عێراقی.
description.kmr: Pakêja înternetê ya mehane: 10 GB ji bo 30 rojan bi 10,000 dînarî.

subscribe.en: To subscribe, dial *321*1# or send NET10 to 1234.
subscribe.ar: للاشتراك، اطلب *321*1# أو أرسل NET10 إلى 1234.
subscribe.ckb: بۆ بەشداریکردن، *321*1# لێبدە یان NET10 بنێرە بۆ 1234.
subscribe.kmr: Ji bo aboneyê, *321*1# bigire yan NET10 bişîne bo 1234.

unsubscribe.en: To unsubscribe, send STOP NET10 to 1234.
unsubscribe.ar: لإلغاء الاشتراك، أرسل STOP NET10 إلى 1234.
unsubscribe.ckb: بۆ هەڵوەشاندنەوە، STOP NET10 بنێرە بۆ 1234.
unsubscribe.kmr: Ji bo betalkirinê, STOP NET10 bişîne bo 1234.

attributes.review_note: PLACEHOLDER entity — invented values and shortcodes; replace with a real ATL internet bundle from the catalogue (seed-20, docs/07 §9). ⚠ RETIRED 2026-09-12. Reason: a usefulness probe found the invented placeholders ranking #1 on 6 of 24 realistic customer questions and in the top 3 on 11 of 24 — they outranked the 50 real FEBRA bundles because they were the only entities with BOTH aliases and how_to, so they were the richest documents in the index. Worst observed case: "how do I subscribe to Weekly TikTok?" returned bundle_1603 subscribe at fused score 1.00, offering the INVENTED code "dial *321*2# or send NET2 to 1234". The invented Shukran definition was also the material a 3B model borrowed to fabricate a definition of "Eshrat Omar". Retired rather than deleted so the record and the gold-set history survive; `status: retired` is excluded from every query by buildFilter(). To bring one back, author it from a real source and set status accordingly. Super Net Monthly — entirely invented (name, price, shortcodes).
